title: Zakah adviser calculations and cases
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Sawm, Zakah and Khums, Hajj (3.3 to 3.5)
source: Written for islamic-studies/y10 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: zakah adviser calculations and cases)
intro: Lesson 45: 3.4 Zakah in practice: calculation, recipients and collection. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

questions.q: Yusuf: £4,000 cash and £2,000 savings for a lunar year; owes £600 now; nisab £450.
Ali: £8,400 savings for a year; no debts; above the nisab.

questions.a: £1,200 - £900 = £300; below £450, so no zakah is due

questions.q: Ibrahim: £2,000 cash and £500 in trade goods for a year; owes £300; nisab £450.
Khadijah: £20,000 savings, but she only reached the nisab four months ago.
questions.a: No zakah yet: a full lunar year (hawl) above the nisab has not passed

questions.q: A family who cannot afford food and rent: can they receive zakah?
questions.a: Yes: the poor and the needy (9:60)

questions.q: A traveller whose wallet was stolen far from home: can they receive zakah?
Your own parents: can they receive zakah?
questions.a: No: you are already responsible for supporting them

model.title: Yusuf holds £4,000 cash and £2,000 savings for a lunar year, and owes £600 due now. The nisab (silver) is £450 in this example. What zakah is due?

cards: A family that cannot pay rent
Someone in debt for basic needs
A non-profit building a sports centre
blocks.title: Sort into: Can receive zakah / Cannot receive zakah
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Can receive zakah, Cannot receive zakah.
blocks.answer: Can receive zakah: A family that cannot pay rent; A refugee stranded without money; Someone in debt for basic needs. Cannot receive zakah: The payer's own child; A wealthy neighbour; A non-profit building a sports centre

panels.title: From the rich to the poor
points: Taken from their rich, given to their poor
Collection by the state or trusted charities

keywords.def: someone in debt they cannot pay

questions.q: Calculate: Ali has £8,400 savings held a year, no debts, above the nisab. What zakah is due?

Zakah adviser on the pupil PDF: five calculations (with debts and different nisab values) and three recipient cases; then a 6-mark answer in the portal response box: 'Explain how zakah helps to meet the needs of the poor.' Start: 'Zakah helps the poor because ...'
questions.a: Calculations per the key (2.5% of net zakatable wealth above nisab); recipients per 9:60; 6-mark with 9:60 and the Mu'adh hadith, developed

questions.q: Extend: why is zakah not given to your own parents or children?
questions.a: You are already responsible for supporting them; zakah goes to others in need

questions.q: Fatimah has £20,000 above the nisab for a year. Her zakah is ...

questions.a: Both valid; weigh need and closeness
